record.original_question: On the Bryant-Salamon G2-manifold R^4 x S^3, Proposition 6 gives a local 1-parameter family of SU(2)^2 x U(1)-invariant G2-instantons with gauge group SU(2) that extend smoothly over the singular orbit on the bundle P_id, and Theorem 5 shows that the member with parameter y_0 = 0 extends globally. Do any of the other local instantons from that family, namely those with y_0 != 0, also extend globally, and if they do, is their curvature necessarily unbounded at infinity?

evidence.quote: Proposition 6. Let S^3 be the singular orbit in the Bryant-Salamon R^4 x S^3. There is a one-parameter family of SU(2)^2 x U(1)-invariant G2-instantons, with gauge group SU(2), defined in a neighbourhood of S^3 and smoothly extending over S^3 on Pid.
Theorem 5. The G2-instanton A_lim arising from the case when y0 = 0 in Proposition 6 is given by ... Moreover, A_lim extends as a SU(2)^3-invariant G2-instanton to the Bryant-Salamon R^4 x S^3.

We have seen that the local G2-instanton defined on Pid given by Proposition 6 for y0 = 0 extends globally to the Bryant-Salamon R^4 x S^3 by Theorem 5. A concrete question is whether any of the other local G2-instantons from Proposition 6 for y0 != 0 extend globally or not. Some numerical investigation suggests that if they do, their curvature is unbounded at infinity.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $(M,\varphi)$ denote the Bryant–Salamon $G_2$-holonomy manifold $M = \mathbb{R}^4 \times S^3$, regarded as the spinor bundle of $S^3$ equipped with its complete torsion-free $G_2$-structure $\varphi$ of cohomogeneity one under the natural action of $SU(2)^2 \times U(1)$, with singular orbit the associative $3$-sphere $S^3 \subset M$. Over the principal stratum, the isotropy of a point is the diagonal $U(1)$ and one has the principal $SO(4)$-bundle of frames; restrict attention to the $SU(2)$-bundle $P_{\mathrm{id}} \to M$ corresponding to the identity homomorphism $U(1) \hookrightarrow SU(2)$ (so that $P_{\mathrm{id}}$ extends smoothly across the singular orbit $S^3$).

A connection $A$ on $P_{\mathrm{id}}$ with curvature $F_A$ is a $G_2$-instanton if $F_A \wedge \psi = 0$, where $\psi = *\varphi$ is the coassociative $4$-form of $\varphi$.

Suppose it is known that there exists a smooth one-parameter family $\{A_{y_0}\}_{y_0 \in \mathbb{R}}$ of $SU(2)^2 \times U(1)$-invariant $G_2$-instantons on $P_{\mathrm{id}}$, each defined on an open neighbourhood of $S^3$ in $M$ and extending smoothly across $S^3$, and that the distinguished member $A_0$ corresponding to $y_0 = 0$ extends to a globally defined $SU(2)^3$-invariant $G_2$-instanton on all of $M$.

Determine:
(a) whether there exists any $y_0 \neq 0$ for which the locally defined $G_2$-instanton $A_{y_0}$ extends to a smooth $G_2$-instanton on the whole of $M = \mathbb{R}^4 \times S^3$;
(b) for every such $y_0 \neq 0$ for which a global extension exists, whether the pointwise norm $|F_{A_{y_0}}|$ of the curvature, measured with respect to the Bryant–Salamon metric, is necessarily unbounded as one tends to infinity in $M$.
artifact.status_search_result: Subsequent works by Alonso (arXiv:2311.08378, "New examples of G_2-instantons on R^4 x S^3") and related Springer papers on G_2-instantons on the spinor bundle of S^3 study families of SU(2)^2-invariant G_2-instantons on R^4 x S^3, but I could not find a publicly accessible source explicitly resolving whether the y_0 ≠ 0 members of the relevant one-parameter family on P_id extend globally on the Bryant–Salamon metric, nor confirming the predicted unboundedness of curvature at infinity. The status therefore appears unverified from the available search.

status_evidence.title: New examples of G_2-instantons on R^4 x S^3
status_evidence.snippet: Existence of SU(2)^2-invariant G_2-instantons and a 1-parameter family on the identity bundle is proved on R^4 x S^3 with coclosed G_2-structures.
status_evidence.claim: Related follow-up work constructs further families of SU(2)^2-invariant G_2-instantons but does not appear to settle the global extension question for y_0 ≠ 0 on the Bryant–Salamon metric.

status_evidence.title: G_2-Instantons on the Spinor Bundle of the 3-Sphere
status_evidence.snippet: Studies G_2-instantons on the spinor bundle of S^3, including invariant families.
status_evidence.claim: Content was not directly accessible; no clear statement of resolution of the y_0 ≠ 0 global extension problem was found.
